_comment: The ONE config for affiliate links. Each partner links to plain_url until affiliate_url is filled in. To turn a partner on, paste the tracked link from the network into affiliate_url; every placement picks it up and gains rel=sponsored plus the disclosure line. lib/affiliates.ts reads this file; lib/__tests__/affiliates.test.ts pins its shape.
